title: claytonia conferta
intro: Claytonia conferta, commonly known as Spring purslane or Miner's lettuce, is a perennial plant native to the western United States and Canada. This plant is rich in nutrients and has been used for its medicinal properties, providing health benefits such as being a rich source of vitamins A and C, potassium, and iron, making it an excellent addition to salads and a natural remedy for anemia and scurvy. The therapeutic actions of Claytonia conferta include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help soothe digestive issues and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal effects.
